goal: Detect an upstream Windows libstdc++ bug that fails when overwriting existing files
Protect wallet migration code that relies on overwriting backup files across affected GCC toolchains
agreement: Support because adding the test seems harmless (maflcko)
Questions whether testing an upstream compiler bug is useful when user impact is low (fanquake, theuni)
Suggests rejecting affected compilers at configure or making migration not overwrite (maflcko, theuni)

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because it adds unit test coverage for an upstream Windows compiler bug during file copying
The benefit is marginal because real-world user impact from this toolchain bug is practically nonexistent
